My first go would be to extend twine for your use because:

1. Twine is open source and you said you want to make an app. Starting with a good prior and building on it will give better results. 

2. Blygs will strictly be online and there’s nothing particularly special about blygs, they are more efficient at creating links but the structure is not an app in itself. 


You could also consider making something to specifically support your stories.
